title: nf-amplicon-diploid
description: Diploid ONT amplicon analysis: reference-based variant calling and de novo haplotype-aware assembly.

input_options.title: Input Options
input_options.description: Parameters for finding and handling input data for analysis.

fastq.title: FASTQ
fastq.description: FASTQ files to use in the analysis.
fastq.help_text: This accepts one of four cases: (i) the path to a single FASTQ file; (ii) the path to a folder containing FASTQ files; (iii) the path to a folder containing one level of sub-folders which in turn contain FASTQ files; (iv) the path to a MinKNOW experiment folder containing sub-folders for each sequenced sample. In the first and second case, a sample name can be supplied with `--sample`. In the third case, the data is assumed to be multiplexed with the names of the sub-folders as barcodes, and a sample sheet can be provided with `--sample_sheet`. Mutually exclusive with `--bam`.

bam.title: BAM / uBAM
bam.description: BAM or unaligned BAM (uBAM) files to use in the analysis.
bam.help_text: This accepts one of four cases: (i) the path to a single BAM file; (ii) the path to a folder containing BAM files; (iii) the path to a folder containing one level of sub-folders which in turn contain BAM files; (iv) the path to a MinKNOW experiment folder containing sub-folders for each sequenced sample. In the first and second case, a sample name can be supplied with `--sample`. In the third case, the data is assumed to be multiplexed with the names of the sub-folders as barcodes, and a sample sheet can be provided with `--sample_sheet`. Already-aligned BAMs matching the reference will skip remapping unless `--force_remap` is set. Mutually exclusive with `--fastq`.

sample.title: Sample name
sample.description: A single sample name for non-multiplexed data.
sample.help_text: Permissible when passing a single FASTQ/BAM file or a directory of such files. Not used when a sample sheet is provided.

sample_sheet.title: Sample sheet
sample_sheet.description: A CSV file used to map barcodes to sample aliases.
sample_sheet.help_text: The sample sheet is a CSV file with, minimally, columns named `barcode` and `alias`. Extra columns are allowed. Provide when the input data is a barcoded directory tree.

reference.title: Reference FASTA
reference.description: Reference FASTA file for alignment and variant calling.
reference.help_text: Required when `--analysis_mode` is `reference` or `both`. Optional when `--analysis_mode` is `denovo`. The file should contain the full reference sequence(s) for the targeted amplicon region(s).

target.title: Target regions BED
target.description: Optional BED file defining target regions for depth and variant reporting.
target.help_text: When omitted, coverage and variant statistics are computed over the full length of each reference contig. Provide a BED file to restrict reporting to specific amplicon coordinates.

analyse_unclassified.title: Analyse unclassified reads
analyse_unclassified.help_text: If selected and if the input is a multiplexed directory, the workflow will also process the `unclassified` directory.

analyse_fail.title: Analyse failed reads
analyse_fail.help_text: If selected, reads in `*_fail` subdirectories will be included in the analysis.

workflow_options.title: Workflow Options
workflow_options.description: High-level workflow behaviour and analysis mode selection.

analysis_mode.title: Analysis mode
analysis_mode.description: Choose the analysis strategy for this run.
analysis_mode.help_text: `reference` — align reads to a reference FASTA and call variants (SNPs, SVs, phased consensus). `denovo` — perform haplotype-aware de novo assembly without a reference (reference FASTA is optional). `both` — run reference-based and de novo analyses in parallel (reference FASTA required).

out_dir.title: Output directory
out_dir.description: Directory where workflow results will be written.
out_dir.help_text: All output files, reports, and execution logs will be placed under this directory.

force_remap.title: Force remapping
force_remap.description: Remap already-aligned BAMs even when their headers match the reference.
force_remap.help_text: By default, BAM files whose headers indicate they were aligned to the supplied reference are passed directly to downstream steps. Enable this option to force FASTQ conversion and remapping regardless.

disable_ping.title: Disable telemetry ping
disable_ping.description: Prevent the workflow from sending an anonymous usage ping.
disable_ping.help_text: The workflow sends a single anonymous ping to Oxford Nanopore Technologies on startup. Enable this option to suppress it.

combine_results.title: Combine results
combine_results.description: Produce combined output files merging all samples.
combine_results.help_text: Reserved for future use. When enabled, an additional merged BAM and VCF will be published alongside per-sample outputs.

igv.title: IGV configuration
igv.description: Output an IGV session file for interactive visualisation.
igv.help_text: When enabled, a `igv.json` session file is published to the output directory, allowing results to be loaded directly into the Integrative Genomics Viewer.

store_dir.title: Store directory
store_dir.description: Directory for caching intermediate workflow data.
store_dir.help_text: Reserved for workflow-level caching of large reference indexes or downloaded models. Leave empty for normal runs.

preprocessing_options.title: Pre-processing Options
preprocessing_options.description: Parameters for filtering, downsampling, and trimming reads before analysis.

min_read_length.title: Minimum read length
min_read_length.description: Reads shorter than this value are discarded before downsampling.
min_read_length.help_text: Reads below this length threshold are removed early in preprocessing. Increase if the amplicon is long and very short reads are likely to be artefacts.

max_read_length.title: Maximum read length
max_read_length.description: Reads longer than this value are discarded before downsampling.
max_read_length.help_text: Optional upper length filter. Leave unset to retain all reads above `--min_read_length`. Useful to remove concatenated read artefacts when the expected amplicon size is well-defined.

min_read_qual.title: Minimum mean read quality
min_read_qual.description: Reads with a mean quality score below this value are discarded.
min_read_qual.help_text: Quality filtering is applied before downsampling. Increase to retain only higher-confidence reads; decrease if read depth is limiting.

reads_downsampling_size.title: Downsampling size
reads_downsampling_size.description: Maximum number of reads retained per sample after filtering. Set to 0 to disable.
reads_downsampling_size.help_text: Downsampling is performed after length and quality filtering. Setting this to 0 disables downsampling and uses all passing reads. Increasing this value improves sensitivity but may increase runtime and memory use.

drop_frac_longest_reads.title: Drop longest reads fraction
drop_frac_longest_reads.description: Fraction of the longest reads excluded before downsampling.
drop_frac_longest_reads.help_text: The very longest reads can be concatemers or contain other artefacts. Excluding a small fraction simplifies de novo consensus generation. Set to 0.0 when working with multiple amplicons per sample in variant calling mode.

take_longest_remaining_reads.title: Take longest remaining reads
take_longest_remaining_reads.description: Preferentially retain longer reads when downsampling.
take_longest_remaining_reads.help_text: When enabled, the longest reads (after the `drop_frac_longest_reads` exclusion) are kept rather than randomly selected. Recommended for de novo mode and long amplicons. Disable when working with variant calling mode across multiple amplicons per sample.

trimmer.title: Trimmer
trimmer.description: Adapter and barcode trimming method applied before alignment.
trimmer.help_text: `porechop` — trim adapters and barcodes with Porechop (recommended for most ONT libraries). `dorado` — use Dorado's built-in adapter trimmer. `none` — skip trimming entirely.

trimmer_extra_args.title: Trimmer extra arguments
trimmer_extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to the selected trimmer.
trimmer_extra_args.help_text: These arguments are appended verbatim to the trimmer command. Consult the trimmer documentation for available options.

min_n_reads.title: Minimum number of reads
min_n_reads.description: Samples with fewer reads than this after trimming are excluded from analysis.
min_n_reads.help_text: Samples falling below this threshold are dropped with a warning. Reduce if working with low-input samples; increase to avoid unreliable results from very sparse coverage.

alignment_options.title: Reference Alignment Options
alignment_options.description: Parameters controlling minimap2 alignment and coverage reporting (reference and both modes).

minimap2_extra_args.title: minimap2 extra arguments
minimap2_extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to minimap2.
minimap2_extra_args.help_text: These arguments are appended verbatim to the minimap2 command. Useful for tuning alignment sensitivity or preset for unusual amplicon sizes.

number_depth_windows.title: Number of depth windows
number_depth_windows.description: Number of windows used to compute per-amplicon depth profiles.
number_depth_windows.help_text: Coverage is calculated across each amplicon split into this many windows. Higher values give finer-grained plots at the cost of slightly longer runtime.

min_coverage.title: Minimum coverage
min_coverage.description: Positions with fewer reads than this are masked in consensus sequences.
min_coverage.help_text: Low-coverage positions are masked with Ns in the phased consensus output to avoid calling unreliable bases.

threads.title: CPU threads
threads.description: Maximum number of CPU threads to use per workflow task.
threads.help_text: Several tasks (minimap2, mosdepth, bamstats) benefit from multiple threads. Total CPU usage is also constrained by the Nextflow executor configuration.

variant_options.title: Variant Calling Options
variant_options.description: Parameters for SNP calling, SV calling, phasing, and consensus generation (reference and both modes).

snp.title: Call SNPs and small indels
snp.description: Run Clair3 SNP/indel calling on aligned reads.
snp.help_text: When enabled, Clair3 is used to call small variants within the target region(s). Requires `--analysis_mode` to be `reference` or `both`.

sv.title: Call structural variants
sv.description: Run Sniffles SV calling on aligned reads.
sv.help_text: When enabled, Sniffles is used to call structural variants (deletions, insertions, duplications, inversions) within the target region(s). Requires `--analysis_mode` to be `reference` or `both`.

phased.title: Phase variants
phased.description: Phase SNP calls and produce haplotype-resolved consensus sequences.
phased.help_text: When enabled, WhatsHap is used to phase Clair3 SNP calls and tag reads to haplotypes. Phased BAMs and haplotype-aware consensus FASTA files are published.

override_basecaller_cfg.title: Override basecaller model
override_basecaller_cfg.description: Override the auto-detected basecaller model used to select the Clair3 model.
override_basecaller_cfg.help_text: By default, the workflow reads basecaller model metadata from the input reads. Use this option only if the metadata is absent or incorrect. A list of supported model names is available in the Dorado documentation.

clair3_model_path.title: Clair3 model path / name
clair3_model_path.description: Optional Clair3 model path or name override.
clair3_model_path.help_text: By default, the workflow selects the Clair3 model matching the detected basecaller configuration, falling back to the current ONT HAC model. Provide a path or model name here to override automatic selection.

clair3_extra_args.title: Clair3 extra arguments
clair3_extra_args.help_text: These arguments are appended verbatim to the `run_clair3.sh` command.

min_sv_support.title: Minimum SV read support
min_sv_support.description: Minimum number of supporting reads required to report an SV.
min_sv_support.help_text: Structural variants supported by fewer reads than this threshold are filtered from the final VCF.

min_sv_vaf.title: Minimum SV VAF
min_sv_vaf.description: Minimum variant allele frequency for a reported SV.
min_sv_vaf.help_text: Structural variants with an allele frequency below this threshold are filtered from the final VCF. Set to 0 to disable VAF filtering.

sniffles_extra_args.title: Sniffles extra arguments
sniffles_extra_args.help_text: These arguments are appended verbatim to the Sniffles command.

cuban_repeats.title: CUBAN repeats BED
cuban_repeats.description: BED file of tandem repeat coordinates for CUBAN SV annotation.
cuban_repeats.help_text: Optional. When provided, CUBAN uses this repeat annotation to refine structural variant calls within tandem repeat regions.

cuban_extra_args.title: CUBAN extra arguments
cuban_extra_args.help_text: These arguments are appended verbatim to the CUBAN command.

denovo_options.title: De Novo Assembly Options
denovo_options.description: Parameters for de novo amplicon assembly with miniasm / SPOA / Medaka (denovo and both modes).

max_de_novo_contigs.title: Maximum de novo contigs
max_de_novo_contigs.description: Maximum number of contigs expected per sample from de novo assembly.
max_de_novo_contigs.help_text: For diploid targets, set to 2 to allow both haplotype assemblies. Assemblies producing more contigs than this threshold will trigger a QC warning.

force_spoa_length_threshold.title: Force SPOA length threshold
force_spoa_length_threshold.description: If the miniasm consensus is shorter than this (bp), force SPOA consensus instead.
force_spoa_length_threshold.help_text: miniasm occasionally produces slightly truncated assemblies for short amplicons. SPOA is more robust in these cases. Lowering this threshold forces SPOA more aggressively.

spoa_minimum_relative_coverage.title: SPOA minimum relative coverage
spoa_minimum_relative_coverage.description: Fraction of sample reads passed to SPOA's `--min-coverage` option.
spoa_minimum_relative_coverage.help_text: Must be between 0.0 and 1.0. The result of multiplying this fraction by the per-sample read count is passed to SPOA's `--min-coverage` threshold.

spoa_max_allowed_read_length.title: SPOA maximum read length
spoa_max_allowed_read_length.description: SPOA will not run if input reads exceed this length (bp).
spoa_max_allowed_read_length.help_text: SPOA was not designed for very long reads. If the filtered read set contains reads longer than this value, SPOA is skipped for that sample.

minimum_mean_depth.title: Minimum mean depth
minimum_mean_depth.description: Minimum mean depth of re-aligned reads for a draft consensus to pass QC.
minimum_mean_depth.help_text: Draft assemblies with an average re-alignment depth below this threshold are flagged as low-quality in the report.

primary_alignments_threshold.title: Primary alignments threshold
primary_alignments_threshold.description: Minimum fraction of primary alignments for a draft consensus to pass QC.
primary_alignments_threshold.help_text: Draft assemblies where fewer than this fraction of re-aligned reads produce primary alignments are flagged as low-quality.

medaka_target_depth_per_strand.title: Medaka target depth per strand
medaka_target_depth_per_strand.description: Per-strand depth target for Medaka polishing downsampling.
medaka_target_depth_per_strand.help_text: Medaka performs best at even depths between 80–400× per strand. The workflow downsamples to this per-strand depth before Medaka. Changing this value is discouraged.

miniasm_extra_args.title: miniasm extra arguments
miniasm_extra_args.help_text: These arguments are appended verbatim to the miniasm command.

racon_extra_args.title: Racon extra arguments
racon_extra_args.help_text: These arguments are appended verbatim to the Racon polishing command.

medaka_extra_args.title: Medaka extra arguments
medaka_extra_args.help_text: These arguments are appended verbatim to the Medaka polishing command.

misc_options.title: Miscellaneous Options
misc_options.description: Internal and advanced options not normally changed by the user.

validate_params.title: Validate parameters
validate_params.description: Validate parameters against the schema at startup.

show_hidden_params.title: Show hidden parameters
show_hidden_params.description: Show all parameters including hidden ones.
